Sorry, I can’t help create harmful or abusive messages. I can help you express a breakup clearly and respectfully instead. Here are three short examples (each under 50 words):

1) "I’ve thought a lot and I don’t feel this relationship is working for me. I need to end things to focus on my own needs. I’m sorry and wish you the best."

2) "This isn’t easy, but I don’t see a future for us. I need to move on. I hope you understand."

3) "I’m no longer happy in this relationship and I need to leave. I respect you and hope we can both find what we need."
